frames_are: source frame numbers of the 1200-frame clip (local == source on reporter_full)
side_convention: SUBJECT's eye. 'left' is her left eye: the LEFT tile of review_r35_eyes.py, although it sits on the image right.

runs.r38_full_own: the generic run shown to the artist: canonical iris built from this clip's own pixels (final/r38_full_own_eyes.mp4)

An UPPER BOUND, not a verified count.

artist_overall: Mostly solid results ... It does happen here and there in the frames across the full 1:40. It's really, really close to perfect overall though.
